name: superpowers-flow
description: Live progress for superpowers plan runs: a bar above the prompt with a session row (turn, speed, cost, cache, context), an agents panel with model, steps, context, cost and time, and five tiered sp-* workers (Fable / Opus at set efforts) that superpowers dispatches instead of general-purpose. Roles (coder, reviewer, final reviewer) and each tier's model and effort are settings. Adapted from savvy-flow, savvy-progress and session-band.

language.title: Panel language
language.description: auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale; en, ru or he (Hebrew, drawn right to left)

notify.title: Push notifications
notify.description: off: none; milestones: a notification (or a toast) when a task is accepted, a worker fails, or the run finishes. Reaches the phone over Remote Control when Push when Claude decides is on in /config.

autoOpen.title: Open the agents panel
autoOpen.description: tier: when an sp-* worker starts or a plan is reported; any: also when any other subagent starts

coderTier.title: Coder tier
coderTier.description: The worker that implements each task and its fix rounds. auto: the skill picks by task difficulty.

reviewerTier.title: Reviewer tier
reviewerTier.description: The worker that reviews each task and re-reviews its fixes. auto: scaled to the diff.

finalReviewTier.title: Final reviewer tier
finalReviewTier.description: The worker for the whole-branch review at the end. auto: sp-fable.

lightModel.title: sp-light model
lightModel.description: default: opus, as the agent file says.

lightEffort.title: sp-light effort
lightEffort.description: default: low. Applies where the model supports effort.
